entities.summary: Esteban Escudero Torres was a Spanish Roman Catholic prelate and theologian. He was bishop of Palencia from 2010 to 2015 and auxiliary bishop of Valencia twice from 2000 to 2010 and from 2015 to 2021. Escudero died in Valencia on 2 May 2025 at the age of 79.
